verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Token2 key management over NFC through the fido2-manage tool and a mobile companion app for configuring keys on Android and iOS. Neither documents tapping a key on a phone over NFC to authenticate in mobile browsers or apps. Management tooling is an adjacent feature and does not deliver mobile NFC authentication.

support.subject: As a power user, I can tap the key on my phone over NFC to authenticate in mobile browsers and apps

citations.quote: fido2-manage is an open-source tool allowing to manage FIDO2.1 devices over USB or NFC
Open-source mobile companion application for configuring and managing FIDO2 security keys on Android and iOS devices.
